+
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException
+from fastapi.security import APIKeyHeader, HTTPBearer, HTTPDigest, OpenIdConnect
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from starlette.status import HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
+import pytest
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+# APIKeyHeader
+api_key_header = APIKeyHeader(name="X-API-Key")
+@app.get("/api-key")
+def read_api_key(api_key: str = Depends(api_key_header)):
+    return {"api_key": api_key}
+
+# HTTPBearer
+http_bearer = HTTPBearer()
+@app.get("/bearer")
+def read_bearer(token = Depends(http_bearer)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+# HTTPDigest
+http_digest = HTTPDigest()
+@app.get("/digest")
+def read_digest(token = Depends(http_digest)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+# OpenIdConnect
+http_oidc = OpenIdConnect(openIdConnectUrl="https://example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration")
+@app.get("/oidc")
+def read_oidc(token = Depends(http_oidc)):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+# Workaround: APIKeyHeader with 403
+api_key_header_403 = APIKeyHeader(name="X-API-Key-403", not_authenticated_status_code=HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
+@app.get("/api-key-403")
+def read_api_key_403(api_key: str = Depends(api_key_header_403)):
+    return {"api_key": api_key}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_api_key_401():
+    response = client.get("/api-key")
+    assert response.status_code == HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED
+    assert response.headers["WWW-Authenticate"] == "ApiKey"
+
+def test_bearer_401():
+    response = client.get("/bearer")
+    assert response.status_code == HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED
+    assert response.headers["WWW-Authenticate"] == "Bearer"
+
+def test_digest_401():
+    response = client.get("/digest")
+    assert response.status_code == HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED
+    assert response.headers["WWW-Authenticate"] == "Digest"
+
+def test_oidc_401():
+    response = client.get("/oidc")
+    assert response.status_code == HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED
+    assert response.headers["WWW-Authenticate"] == "Bearer"
+
+def test_api_key_403_workaround():
+    response = client.get("/api-key-403")
+    assert response.status_code == HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_api_key_401()
+        test_bearer_401()
+        test_digest_401()
+        test_oidc_401()
+        test_api_key_403_workaround()
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        raise e
